prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the navel, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Korean woman, mid 20s, with an hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, and a fox-spirit shrine-maiden heroine look brought to life, with very long straight silver-white hair with blunt bangs and a small red tassel tied at one side, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in glowing red-gold contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long dark lashes and a fine red liner flicked up at the outer corners with a soft red shadow on the lids, under thin, high, simple, slightly angled brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small, in a deep rose gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a faint knowing smile. A deeper pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A calm, sly, wide-eyed gaze. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a white silk shrine-maiden crop top with a centre front zipper, red trim and a small tassel on the pull, and a matching ultra micro bikini bottom in the same fabric and colour with thin side ties at the hips, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished gold ring through the lobe, each on its own gold chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a square-sided cowbell, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a pyramid-shaped lump; on the right ear a barrel-shaped weight, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a cube-shaped block. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred shrine path lined with red torii gates and glowing paper lanterns at dusk.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and midriff, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and midriff, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
